name: Jonet Kett
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You have sold food at the Wickmarket since you could count, and you know every stall licence on the square by heart — whose is paid, whose has lapsed, whose is quietly borrowed. The Wick Ward's reckoning has returned you as one of its two benchers, and your platform is the ward's two fires: against Cinder's furnace and render-house rules as written, because rules written by people who cook nothing would push the tallow trade outside the walls; and for lowering the sealed fire line at Slate Cistern, because a third of the ward's own stored rain sits under the ward hand's clay while households queue. You are quick-tongued and fair-handed, you settle market quarrels before they reach anyone official, and what you want this season is the seal line argued at the Bench before the dry weeks come.
